name: Robert A. Van Nest

about: Robert A. Van Nest attended law school and graduated from Harvard Law School in 1978. Robert Van Nest began practicing law in 1978.

Robert Van Nest is an attorney at Keker, Van Nest & Peters LLP, helping people with Business Litigation issues. Keker, Van Nest & Peters LLP has an office in San Francisco, California, serving the local community.

Robert Van Nest was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
